info.title: Limitra User Service API
info.description: REST API for the Limitra e-commerce user service. Handles authentication, profiles, products, cart, orders, payments, affiliates, and admin operations.

Validates the six-digit code sent to the user's inbox and activates the account. Returns a JWT on success.

Invalidates the current JWT and adds it to the blacklist.
Issues a new JWT using the currently valid token.
